Klasse AttackMoves

java.lang.Object
feu.agenten.shogo_seifert.AbstractMoves
moveCategories.AttackMoves
public class AttackMoves extends AbstractMoves
Collection of attacking moves.

These moves are used to actively attack and eliminating nodes controlled by the enemy to reduce the enemies strength.

The class extends AbstractMoves and therefore has access to the shared game state and helper methods.

  • Methodendetails

    • fightWeakestEnemiesBestPlacement

      public String fightWeakestEnemiesBestPlacement(Map<Integer,Integer> budget, int limit, double factor)
      Generates several attack moves against enemy nodes.

      Enemy nodes are getting attacked in ascending order of strength. For each enemy, the best node for the attack gets calculated. The threshold of necessary Fernies for a (probably) successful attack gets calculated.

      If the threshold is too high for the remaining budget, the enemy node gets skipped. After each move, the remaining budget and the newFernies get updated by the used number of (new) Fernies.

      The method executes attack actions until the budget is used.

      See fightStrongestEnemiesBestPlacement(Map, int, double) for the corresponding method that fights the strong enemy Nodes first.

      Parameter:
      budget - the budget of the Fernies currently available
      limit - the minimum number of Fernies that shall stay on a node after the move
      factor - the scaling factor applied to the calculated enemy strength to control the aggressiveness of the attack
      Gibt zurück:
      a move String containing several generated attack actions
